# Beyond Book Publishing
> Beyond Book Publishing (BeyondBookpublishing.com) is a full-service, author-first book publishing house providing professional ghostwriting, developmental editing, copy editing, custom cover design, global distribution, and strategic book marketing. Authors retain 100% of royalties, 100% of copyright, and 100% creative control.

## Overview
- Brand Name: Beyond Book Publishing
- Official Website: https://beyondbookpublishing.com
- Domain: BeyondBookpublishing.com
- Primary Services: Ghostwriting, Book Editing, Self-Publishing, Book Cover Design, Book Marketing, Audiobook Production
- Core Promise: 100% Royalties to Authors, Zero Rights Surrender, Zero AI Hallucinations / Human-Crafted Manuscripts
- Contact Email: info@beyondbookpublishing.com
- Phone: +1 (800) 555-0199
- Office Location: Manhattan, New York, NY, USA

## Core Services
- [Ghostwriting](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/services/ghost-writing): Non-fiction, business books, fiction, thrillers, fantasy, romance, and memoirs. Handled by veteran ghostwriters.
- [Book Editing](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/services/copy-editing): Three-tier editorial pipeline including developmental structural editing, line copy editing, and final proofreading.
- [Self-Publishing & Distribution](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/services/self-publishing): Worldwide distribution across Amazon KDP, IngramSpark, Barnes & Noble, Apple Books, Kobo, and 40,000+ bookstores and libraries.
- [Book Cover Design](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/services/book-cover-design): Market-tested, high-converting paperback, hardcover with dust jacket, and eBook covers formatted to printer specifications.
- [Book Marketing](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/services/social-media-marketing): Amazon AMS advertising management, author platform launch, Goodreads optimization, and podcast outreach.
- [Audiobook Production](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/services/audiobook-production): Professional voice actor casting, studio narration, ACX/Audible and Findaway Voices mastering.

## Key Author Resources & Guides
- [The Ultimate Blueprint to Self-Publishing in 2026](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/ultimate-blueprint-self-publishing-2026): Step-by-step master roadmap for modern indie authors.
- [How to Hire an Elite Ghostwriter](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/how-to-hire-elite-ghostwriter-framework): Essential vetting criteria and contract safeguards.
- [The Anatomy of a Bestselling Book Cover](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/anatomy-of-a-bestselling-book-cover): Cover design psychology and thumbnail conversion tactics.
- [Developmental Editing vs. Copy Editing vs. Proofreading](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/developmental-editing-vs-copy-editing-proofreading): Determining exact editorial manuscript needs.
- [Amazon KDP vs. IngramSpark](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/amazon-kdp-vs-ingramspark-hybrid-guide): Maximizing royalties with hybrid print and digital distribution.
- [Writing a Captivating Memoir](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/writing-a-captivating-memoir-guide): Structural pacing for true personal narratives.
- [Book Marketing That Generates Real Royalties](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/book-marketing-that-generates-real-royalties): High-ROI sales funnels and advertising campaigns.
- [The Authority Author](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/the-authority-author-business-book-strategy): How founders and executives leverage books for authority.
- [Audiobook Production on ACX & Findaway](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/audiobook-production-acx-findaway-guide): Audio formatting, voice actor hiring, and distribution.
- [The Children's Book Publishing Playbook](https://beyondbookpublishing.com/blog/childrens-book-publishing-playbook): 32-page layout, illustration bleed, and target age tiers.

## Author Rights & Terms
- Authors own 100% of their intellectual property, copyright, and royalties.
- Zero ongoing royalty cuts or clawbacks taken by Beyond Book Publishing.
- Full files delivered upon completion (PDF, ePub, print interior, high-res covers, source files).
